about.description: Evolve offers a stablecoin backed by real-world assets and Treasury securities, combining yield generation with price stability. It enables institutional-grade stable settlement with underlying RWA collateral.
about.registryInfo: Official docs describe eUSD as a tokenized yield product issued by Evolve, with smart contracts and vault infrastructure powered by YieldFi. No separate public corporate registry identifier for the issuer was located in the reviewed materials.
